Topics · Hard times

Is my long grief a sign of weak faith?

No end date for grief is claimed. A father's eyes whitened with sorrow, unfaulted; love between two is a sign.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ٨٤ قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا۟ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْهَـٰلِكِينَ٨٥ قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ٨٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white[614] from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.[615] They said, "By Allāh, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish." He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.

Translator's notes

[614] i.e., he lost his sight. [615] He did not express the extent of his grief or his anger at what he suspected his sons had done but was patient, depending only upon Allāh for help.

Quran · Yusuf 12:84-86

Translation

I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

Original · Hebrew

ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃ אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃ בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י ׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃

the Psalms · 142:1-3

World English Bible

The Quran does not hurry grief. These verses describe a father whose eyes turned white with sorrow, and who held it in. Those around him said: you will go on remembering until you are ruined. He did not go quiet and he did not apologise. He said he takes his sorrow to God. The text never tells him his faith is weak. Faith and grief lived in him together.

A question for you

Which is closest to what you feel?

If you sayThe missing hurts my body.
ThenYes, grief lives in the body. A father's eyes turned white from sorrow in the text itself.
If you sayI fear my grief means weak faith.
ThenThe verses do not say that. No verse sets a length for grief, or a measure for tears.
If you saySome days I do not want to go on.
ThenThis app cannot hear you or reach anyone for you, so please do not carry this alone. Talk today to someone you trust, a doctor, or a helpline where you live, and if you are in danger now, reach for the nearest person who can help. The sorrow you bring to God is heard.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:21

Translation

Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־ט֛וֹב הֱי֥וֹת הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְבַדּ֑וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶׂהּ־לּ֥וֹ עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃

the Torah (Genesis) · 2:18

World English Bible

The verse calls the love and mercy between two people a sign. If what was between you was a sign, then your grief is not a fault in you. It is the other face of a sign. You are grieving something the text itself honours. Grief is the size of what was.

A question for you

What does this verse hold for you?

If you sayThat what we had was real.
ThenThat is what the verse says, in the language of signs.
If you sayThat my grief matches what was.
ThenThe verse does not say this in its words, but it lets you understand grief this way, and nothing in it contradicts it.
If you sayI do not know. I am only tired.
ThenTiredness is understood. You may stop here, and the next page will wait.

Part 3 of 3

﴿ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَـٰبَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ١٥٦ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَٰتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُهْتَدُونَ١٥٧﴾

Translation of the meaning

Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return." Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the [rightly] guided.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:156-157

Translation

and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

Original · Hebrew

וְיָשֹׁ֧ב הֶעָפָ֛ר עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּשֶׁהָיָ֑ה וְהָר֣וּחַ תָּשׁ֔וּב אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְתָנָֽהּ׃

Ecclesiastes · 12:7

World English Bible

The sentence people say when loss strikes is short: we belong to God, and to Him we return. It is not an order to feel nothing. It says where the one you loved is going, and where you are. The next verse says of those who say it: blessings and mercy from their Lord. A mourner has a mercy with a name.

A question for you

Does grief end? What is the most honest answer?

If you sayNo one knows when.
ThenThat is the most honest answer. The verses promise no date, and this page claims no knowledge beyond them.
If you sayIt changes, but does not leave.
ThenMany have said so. The text does not settle it, but nothing in it conflicts with what they said.
If you sayI do not want it to end; it is all that is left.
ThenLove does not need grief to stay. But no one here asks you to let it go before its time.

The same in the other books

Translation

“Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven. Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν. μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται.

Original · Hebrew

וַאֲנִי֙ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֲצַפֶּ֔ה אוֹחִ֖ילָה לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י יִשְׁמָעֵ֖נִי אֱלֹהָֽי׃ אַֽל־תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י אֹיַ֨בְתִּי֙ לִ֔י כִּ֥י נָפַ֖לְתִּי קָ֑מְתִּי כִּֽי־אֵשֵׁ֣ב בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ יְהוָ֖ה א֥וֹר לִֽי׃

Micah · 7:7-8

World English Bible

Translation

Those who sow in tears will reap in joy. He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

Original · Hebrew

הַזֹּרְעִ֥ים בְּדִמְעָ֗ה בְּרִנָּ֥ה יִקְצֹֽרוּ׃ הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ ׀ וּבָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֪א מֶֽשֶׁךְ־הַ֫זָּ֥רַע בֹּֽ֬א־יָב֥וֹא בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃

the Psalms · 126:5-6

World English Bible

To a good man there is no evil, either in life or death. And if God supply not food, has He not, as a wise Commander, sounded the signal for retreat and nothing more? I obey, I follow—speaking good of my Commander, and praising His acts. For at His good pleasure I came; and I depart when it pleases Him; and while I was yet alive that was my work, to sing praises unto God!
